name: Cold Storage
description: Cold Storage: you are WREN, the last mind awake on a colony ship, with forty sleepers in the hall and a coolant reserve that is never quite enough. Wake one at a time, ask what they hope and fear and would take back, and what you ask becomes what they dream. Run the ship's tired systems, answer the year's small events (a visitor, a lullaby from Earth, a dream two strangers share), and cross the Veil. No hurry, no game over. Type PLAY, or COLDSTOR (COLDSTOR /52 or /ADM for a VT52 or an ADM-3A).
